resources.string: Music from your Plex Media Server.
Use a Plex authentication token with access to this server.
How to find your Plex token
Plex rejected this token. Check that it has access to this server.
Use your Plex Media Server address, usually with port 32400.
Stream from Navidrome, Jellyfin or Plex.
Add a Navidrome, Jellyfin, Plex or YouTube Music account in Settings → Accounts to include it here.
